company: Elephant bird egg (composite, fossil eggshell), seller Diana
product: Pawn Stars clip 'RARE FOSSIL EGG is Very Old & Very Valuable (Season 17)' (YouTube id Tk1px0VYkts, Pawn Stars official channel, Season 17 'Million Dollar Deal'). Rick buys; paleontologist Andre Lujan (Executive Director, Tour Through Time) appraises $5,900; deal $2,800.

facts.fact: Rick jokes 'You must own really large chickens'; seller: no chickens; it's an elephant bird egg.
Seller sells fossils and natural history items; had the egg 15 years; hopes for $2,500 (on-screen tag $2,500).

On-screen captions: extinct since the 17th century, native to Madagascar; largest eggs laid by any vertebrate including dinosaurs; fewer than 40 intact eggs in public collections; 2013 one sold for over $100,000 at a London auction.
Egg is pieced together from several eggs' shells.
Rick: no idea if $2,500 is good or if it's even eggshell; calls paleontologist friend ('egg-spert').
Expert: rare and often faked (porcelain); elephant birds up to 10 feet tall, 1,600 pounds.
Lens on surface shows long grooves expected of elephant bird; actual elephant bird egg, composite; abrasions where pieces were ground into place affect value.
Negotiation: seller now wants $3,000; Rick offers $2,800 (more than asked); seller asks $3,000 again; Rick: offering more than you were asking; $2,800 best; deal at $2,800.
Seller: more than I came in for, so I'm happy.
